placement.hand: same clean, dry dorsal hand for the complete batch
placement.site: optical-window center at the midpoint of the intermetacarpal space between the second and third metacarpals, halfway from the knuckle line to the dorsal wrist crease
placement.orientation: optical window flat against skin; sensor long axis parallel to the third metacarpal; cable exits toward the wrist
placement.representative_housing: VN-001 labeled housing used as the repeatable placement interface; no final assembly or Li-Po
placement.contact_pressure: light and steady: full-window contact with no visible gap, blanching, discomfort, or lasting indentation; qualitative and uncalibrated
placement.posture: seated, forearm fully supported, palm down, fingers naturally extended and relaxed; hand, sensor, housing, and leads remain still
placement.movement_rule: do not move or retune placement within a batch; reject any capture with movement or uncertain contact

start_signal: operator says READY after the settle interval; recorder prints CAPTURE_START with experiment/config/repetition and UTC before enabling START
stop_conditions: pain, discomfort, blanching, or lasting indentation
sensor or housing movement, lead strain, or uncertain contact
identity, configuration, session, or timing uncertainty
any clipped sample, FIFO overflow, packet loss, duplicate, or out-of-order packet
